title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: one sentence for every write over a sealed, package-held name; the inferred create remedy retires
body:
Fixes #23577
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling `6184789291` (batch #348 item 1, letter B) on this card.

## What changed

- **One sentence for every write over a sealed, package-held name** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/packaged-base-regime.ts`, `managedItemSealedSentence`). For a type with no regime row, every write reads: "'TYPE/NAME' is provided by a managed package and is sealed: it cannot be written here. GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE lists the names in use." This holds for every mode and pin: the console's generic create (`mode: 'draft'` + `If-None-Match: *`), a publish-mode `*`, and unpinned and pinned saves. It gives no create advice and no source-artifact advice. The repository's type door (draft promotion, restore, revert) builds the same sentence. Code `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` and status `403` are unchanged.
- **Holding package not named.** Neither door has the artifact's package at hand. `refusePackagedBaseOverride` asks `isSealedManagedItem`, a boolean, and `isArtifactBacked` discards the `lookupArtifactItem` result. `SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed` is told only the write intent. Per the ruling, no lookup is added.
- **Retired (no producer remains):** `sealedWrite` in `saveMetaItem`; the `'create'` member of `packagedBaseRefusal`'s `operation`; the `create` arm of `SealedItemOperation`; `heldNameSentence`; the `operation` parameter of `refusePackagedBaseOverride` and of `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal` (it only ever carried `create`). `runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` passes `'save' | 'delete'` and is untouched.
- **Position 2:** the `## create` section of `packagedBaseRefusal`'s docblock, which named the retired position write-through, is replaced by a short "one `save`, whatever the write meant" note.
- **Spec docblocks (ruling item 2):** `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.version` and `MetadataConflictErrorSchema.currentVersion` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) now say that a `null` beside `editable: false` takes no save and prescribe no pin for it. These are `.describe()` texts. The only generated output that moved is `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, written by `check:generated --fix` (`gen:docs`).
- **Position 3:** the clone door's lost-race 409 came from the protocol's first-write-pin conflict sentence (`metadataConflictRefusal`, "Send that version as If-Match …"), which the clone door relayed through `errorFromThrown`. The fix is in the clone door, the producer of the clone caller's response. A `METADATA_CONFLICT` from its create-only save is rethrown as the door's own name-taken refusal: 409, default code `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, the same sentence a name the catalog already held reads. The `/meta` door's conflict sentence is unchanged, so it stays correct for REST callers that send `If-Match`.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the three rows `check:engine-double-contract --write` adds for the new `view` control harness.
- Changeset `.changeset/23577-sealed-write-one-sentence.md` (minor: metadata-protocol, with the **BREAKING** line and its ADR-0087 disposition; patch: runtime, spec).
- `.changeset/23406-sealed-first-draft-remedy.md` (unconsumed, the same release) is amended in place so it no longer states the draft/publish remedy split this PR retires; it keeps its first-write-pin `409` sentence. A falsified entry is corrected in the entry itself, never by an erratum in a later one (AGENTS.md, the `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row), so this PR's changeset carries no "supersedes" line (`f0761ed3`, the seat's patch round).

## Pins (ruling item 4)

`protocol.sealed-remedy-kind.test.ts` is re-pointed. #23565's draft/publish block now asserts the one sentence. On `position`, `object` and `flow`, on both kernel shapes, these five requests all read the identical refusal: console create (draft + `*`), publish `*`, unpinned draft, unpinned, pinned. For `position` and `object`, that refusal is the ruled sentence. The registry enumeration holds every row-less reachable type to the ruled sentence, under the 500-character bound with an 88-character name. An overlay control shows that a `view` first write pinned `*` over a packaged view lands an overlay row (`success: true`, one row). The clone door has a new lost-race pin: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, the name-taken sentence, and no `If-Match`. #23565's REST-door pin `rest-meta-sealed-first-draft-remedy.test.ts` is re-pointed to the one sentence for the same requests on both kernels (`3f354c73`).

## Verification

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' --filter @objectstack/runtime build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter … run typecheck` for spec, metadata-protocol, runtime: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 236 files passed, 3 skipped; 28418 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 383 files, 5773 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 678 files, 20728 tests passed.
- Touched pins in other packages: `rest-meta-packaged-flow-refusal.test.ts` and `rest-meta-sealed-first-draft-remedy.test.ts` passed 6/6; `objectql protocol-commit-history.test.ts` passed 30/30. CI Test Core 5/6 caught `rest-meta-sealed-first-draft-remedy.test.ts` red at `9ec5053e` (it still pinned the retired split); it was re-pointed in `3f354c73`, and the full `rest` run at `9ec5053e` had its 284 other files green.
- `f0761ed3` (changesets only): `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `pnpm changeset status --since=origin/main`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: one stale artifact (`check:docs`); after `--fix`, re-check green.
- Ablations, committed first, each restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`):
  - Clone guard (`METADATA_CONFLICT` to a renamed code): 1 red / 22 green, predicted 1 red.
  - Sentence builder (the `save` branch disabled): 7 red / 6 green, predicted. The row-less pins went red; flow, reach, removal and the `view` control stayed green.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` local union (114 derived plus 5 roster families under my paths), first run at `51f2e48b`:
  - Real reds, both fixed in `9ec5053e`: `check:durability-log-level` (the clone's new catch; it now rethrows to the door's one `errorFromThrown`) and `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger rows). Both re-run green.
  - Exit 2/3 prerequisites, NOT MEASURED: `check-engine-split-ratio` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone); `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (whole-workspace build absent).
  - The final-head re-run of the union is recorded in the card's report comment.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope of "every write": Regime C and origin-gated rows are kept.** `flow`, `action` and `permission` keep their regime sentence. ADR-0126 §2 requires a Regime C refusal to name its sanctioned path, and those sentences carry neither create advice nor source advice. `datasource` is origin-gated: its items are code-defined, not package-held, and its sentence states the datasource-admin door's own verdict. The ruling's fact base is the row-less pair `managedItemSealedSentence` built. Raised in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Removals unchanged.** Every removal keeps its sentence, the hatch-naming one included.
- **`ITEM_LOCKED` named-base limb unchanged.** When a caller names a read-only base (`readOnlyBaseOverrideError`), the limb keeps its own code and its "Edit the source artifact and redeploy" remedy. The ruling binds the package-less `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` refusal.
- **Unreleased changeset.** `.changeset/23406-sealed-first-draft-remedy.md` described the split this PR retires. It is amended in place (see the What changed list), and the `Check Changeset` step-12 red that this produces is the gate's deliberate-correction class, carried to the maintainer by `needs-user-decision` (comment 6186537521).
- **Breaking declaration.** The `'create'` member of `packagedBaseRefusal`'s `operation` and `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal`'s `operation` parameter are a released public input surface (`18.0.0-next.0`), so the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` changeset carries a `**BREAKING**` line, an ADR-0087 disposition and the launch-window `minor` grade (contract review 6186902880, ②).
- The 409 lost-race answer of the clone door now reads code `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` instead of `METADATA_CONFLICT`. That is the code the door already declares for a taken name.
